description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified DataAgent, including the display name, description, system prompt, assumed RAM role, and associated context models
description_zh: 更新指定 DataAgent 的配置，包括显示名、描述、系统提示词、所扮演的 RAM 角色以及关联的上下文模型
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-data-agent --name order-analysis-agent --context-models order-context --role-arn 'acs:ram::123456789012****:role/sls-dataagent-role' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataAgent

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. It is passed in the request path to locate the DataAgent to be updated. The name itself cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于定位要更新的那个 DataAgent。名称本身不可修改
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of names of context models associated with the DataAgent. This field is required and must contain at least one context model. The update performs a full replacement. The submitted list becomes the complete set of associations after the update
parameters.help_zh: 该 DataAgent 关联的上下文模型名称列表，为必填项，至少关联一个。更新为整体覆盖：本次提交的列表即为更新后的全部关联关系
parameters.name: context_models

parameters.example: 负责分析订单与收入相关日志，并按日输出汇总报表
parameters.help_en: The description of the DataAgent. It describes the scope of responsibilities and applicable scenarios, and is used only for display and search purposes. It does not affect runtime behavior. If this field is not provided or an empty string is provided, the description is cleared. The keyword parameter in the list operation performs a fuzzy match against this description
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的描述，用于说明它的职责范围与适用场景，仅供展示与检索，不影响运行行为；不传或传空串表示清空。列表接口的 keyword 会与该描述做模糊匹配
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The display name. The maximum length is 256 characters, and Chinese characters are supported. This operation performs a full replacement. Not providing this field is equivalent to providing an empty string, which clears the existing display name. To retain the existing display name, submit it with its original value
parameters.help_zh: 显示名，长度上限 256 个字符（按字符数计），可含中文。本接口为整体覆盖：不传该字段等同于传空串，会把已有的显示名清空，如需保留请连同原值一起提交
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the DataAgent to access resources under your account. The format is acs:ram::<Alibaba Cloud account UID>:role/<Role name>. This field is required. When calling this operation as a RAM user or by assuming a role, the caller must also have the ram:PassRole permission for this role. Otherwise, a 401 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 扮演并用于访问您账号下资源的 RAM 角色 ARN，形如 acs:ram::<阿里云账号 UID>:role/<角色名称>，为必填项。使用 RAM 用户或扮演角色调用时，调用者还必须拥有该角色的 ram:PassRole 权限，否则返回 401
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.example: 你是订单域的数据分析助手，只回答与订单、收入相关的问题，不确定时说明原因而不是猜测
parameters.help_en: The system prompt of the DataAgent. It defines the role positioning, capability boundaries, and response style. If this field is not provided or an empty string is provided, the system prompt is cleared
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的系统提示词，用于设定它的角色定位、能力边界与回答风格；不传或传空串表示清空
parameters.name: system_prompt

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the updated DataAgent configuration. The fields are the same as those in the request body
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回更新后的 DataAgent 配置，字段与请求体一致

contextModels.description_en: The list of names of context models associated with the DataAgent after the update
contextModels.description_zh: 更新后该 DataAgent 关联的上下文模型名称列表

items.description_en: The name of a single context model
items.description_zh: 单个上下文模型的名称

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format in the UTC time zone, accurate to seconds
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC 时区的 ISO8601 格式，精确到秒

description.description_en: The updated description of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if it is not set
description.description_zh: 更新后的 DataAgent 描述。未设置时返回空串
description.example: 负责分析订单与收入相关日志，并按日输出汇总报表

displayName.description_en: The updated display name. An empty string "" is returned if it is not set, and it is not backfilled with name. When displaying, fall back to displayName || name
displayName.description_zh: 更新后的显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退
displayName.title_zh: 更新后的显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退。

name.description_en: The name of the DataAgent, which is the same as the name passed in the request path
name.description_zh: DataAgent 的名称，与请求路径中传入的名称一致

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the DataAgent after the update. The format is acs:ram::123456789012****:role/<Role name>
roleArn.description_zh: 更新后 DataAgent 扮演的 RAM 角色 ARN，形如 acs:ram::123456789012****:role/<角色名称>

systemPrompt.description_en: The updated system prompt. An empty string is returned if it is not set
systemPrompt.description_zh: 更新后的系统提示词。未设置时返回空串
systemPrompt.example: 你是订单域的数据分析助手，只回答与订单、收入相关的问题，不确定时说明原因而不是猜测

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the current update takes effect. The format is the same as createdAt
updatedAt.description_zh: 本次更新生效的时间，格式同 createdAt

userId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the DataAgent belongs
userId.description_zh: 该 DataAgent 归属的阿里云账号 ID

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body in JSON format. This operation performs a full replacement. Optional fields not provided in the request body are reset to empty values instead of retaining their original values
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体，JSON 格式。本接口为整体覆盖：请求体中未给出的可选字段会被重置为空值，而不是保留原值
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The request body in JSON format. This operation performs a full replacement. Optional fields not provided in the request body are reset to empty values instead of retaining their original values
v1_parameters.help_zh: 请求体，JSON 格式。本接口为整体覆盖：请求体中未给出的可选字段会被重置为空值，而不是保留原值
v1_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. It is passed in the request path to locate the DataAgent to be updated. The name itself cannot be modified
v1_parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于定位要更新的那个 DataAgent。名称本身不可修改
v1_parameters.name: name
